title: Preflight validation harness for releases: smoke, perf-gate, eval suite integration
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: As we expand LTS channels and rollouts across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments, we need a deterministic preflight validation pipeline that runs before any production rollout. Current gaps: ad-hoc smoke tests, no automated perf/regression gate against canonical workloads, and manual eval runs for model-quality checks. Goal: implement a repeatable, automated preflight harness that runs (1) fast smoke tests for functional regressions, (2) performance regression gates (latency, throughput, cost-per-token) against a pinned benchmark, and (3) model-quality eval suites (semantic similarity / hallucination checks / key eval prompts) for model and runtime changes. This harness will be triggered as a gated step in the release pipeline and will emit an artifact bundle + human-readable report and a pass/fail decision used by rollout automation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) CI job `preflight/release-verify` executes automatically for release branches and produces a single JSON artifact summarizing outcomes. 2) Smoke tests cover critical API surfaces (text generation, streaming, embeddings, KV cache warmup) and must pass deterministically. 3) Perf gate enforces no >10% regression on p50 latency and no >15% regression on p95 vs baseline (baseline per-release archived). 4) Regression on cost-per-token >12% flags for manual review. 5) Eval suite (100 canonical prompts + 10 targeted hallucination prompts) runs and reports quality metrics; any drop >3% absolute on semantic-similarity score requires manual triage. 6) Artifact is stored in release artifacts bucket and dashboard link posted to Slack #releases. 7) Rollout automation reads the gate decision and blocks canary >0% if gate fails.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Kapoor: Kicked off discovery with PM and SRE. Collected existing smoke tests from runtime repo and a list of canonical prompts from Eval team. Noted that current smoke harness uses docker-compose and cannot scale for perf runs.

2026-03-04 - Miguel Santos: Spike complete. Implemented a prototype preflight job that runs smoke tests in a staging cluster and stores logs in GCS. Initial perf harness uses Locust scripts and a small concurrency profile to approximate real traffic.

2026-03-06 - Sofia Chen (SRE): Feedback: perf harness must include KV-cache warmup stage; otherwise first-token latency skews p95. Suggest adding a 60s warmup and synthetic prefix cache hits based on recent traffic histograms.

2026-03-08 - Rahul Desai (PM): Reviewed acceptance criteria. Pushed back on the 3% absolute quality drop — asked to change to signal-based triage for small changes. Decided: keep 3% but add an automatic rerun within a different seed and model config before blocking rollout.
2026-03-10 - Miguel Santos: Implemented rerun logic and artifact schema (preflight-result-v1.json). Created GitHub PR #1247 with pipeline changes. Requesting code review from runtime and infra teams.

2026-03-12 - Design review (DES-2201): UX requested a concise human-readable summary and a clear link to the failing test in console rollouts. Added `short_summary.md` to artifacts and a console webhook to attach the artifact link to the rollout page.
implementation_notes: - Implement a parametrized job in CI (Tekton/GHA) that can target: local-micro, staging, canary. - Use a canonical dataset stored in releases-benchmarks S3 bucket; versioned per-release. - Perf harness: 3 phases (warmup, steady-state, cooldown). Publish p50/p90/p95, tail-percentiles, and cost-per-token. - Eval harness: deterministic seeds, tokenize and compare embeddings using cosine similarity metric; store raw outputs for replay. - Failure mode: gate returns FAIL -> block rollout and create automated issue with logs and triage checklist. - Soft failure mode (quality regressions within tolerance) -> warn and create `release-note` annotation.
next_steps: 1) Merge PR #1247 and enable on runtime-1.20 branch. 2) Add baseline artifact for runtime-1.19 (will be used for perf comparisons). 3) Coordinate with QA to add 20 new canonical prompts covering long-context and tool-calling edge cases. 4) Add Console integration for visual pass/fail and link to detailed artifact. 5) Run preflight on internal canary release and iterate thresholds.
observability_integration: preflight-result-v1.json will feed into preflight-dashboard and Console rollout page via webhook
risks: - Flaky tests due to non-deterministic eval prompts or noisy infra. Mitigation: seed control, isolated staging cluster. - False positives on perf gate when load generator doesn't match production traffic. Mitigation: calibrate using historical traces. - Long runtime for full eval suite could delay rollouts. Mitigation: fast smoke gate + optional extended eval that runs asynchronously and can trigger rollbacks within a rollout window.
owner_approval: 2026-03-11 - Raul Green: Approved the pipeline changes for initial rollout to staging with metrics thresholds as defined.
